findings.explanation: The code does not involve SQL queries, so there is no risk of SQL injection.

The code includes an authorization check to ensure that only the owner of the API key can delete it. This prevents IDOR (CWE-639), missing authorization (CWE-862), and incorrect authorization (CWE-863).

evidence.content:
async def delete_api_key(session: AsyncSession, api_key_id: UUID, user_id: UUID) -> None:
    api_key = await session.get(ApiKey, api_key_id)
    if api_key is None:
        msg = "API Key not found"
        raise ValueError(msg)
    if api_key.user_id != user_id:
        msg = "API Key not found"
        raise ValueError(msg)
